summary.text: Ronald Ellis is a Republican member of the Kansas House of Representatives representing District 47 (Jefferson County), and the Legislature's member page lists service in the House since 2017.

paragraphs.text: Ronald Ellis is listed as a member of the Health and Human Services Committee and the Transportation and Public Safety Budget Committee.
The Legislature lists Ronald Ellis's occupation as Rancher.
The page names Paula as Ronald Ellis's spouse.
